text: Window honesty: the strict 21–22 Nov spine is the МВР cuts, the police protest call, the Подкрепа strike schedule, the personal-assistance/ТЕЛК signal, the КНСБ subsistence line, the NOI open day, the BNB/ECB speech and the НСОРБ restatement. The budget itself was approved 16 Nov and cleared its first-reading committees 17–19 Nov, the VAT amendment and the parents' protest are 19–20 Nov — they are context for the weekend reactions, not same-window news.
